name: Other armed conflicts
value: Ethiopia–Eritrea forces face off at Badme
summary: Drone and artillery strikes reported around Badme as Ethiopia and Eritrea mass forces; interstate war not confirmed
state: Addis Standard reported overnight drone and artillery strikes around Badme on 18–19 Nov amid Ethiopian and Eritrean military build-ups, and ACLED reported Ethiopian forces retaking areas near Badme on 23 Nov. The Critical Threats project recorded the two armies reportedly trading artillery fire around Badme from 11 to 13 Nov, with Eritrea accusing Ethiopia of invasion. Neither government has confirmed direct interstate fighting as of 25 Nov, so the Alert is unconfirmed and Watch holds.
for_you: People in Tigray, Afar and along the Ethiopia–Eritrea border face displacement and disrupted aid. FCDO advises against travel to parts of northern Ethiopia and to the Eritrean border area.
rubric_hit: Watch: significant deterioration on the Ethiopia–Eritrea border; interstate war unconfirmed
